newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles transit agency appoints new executive.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles transit agency appoints new executive.

text.p: Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority Chief Executive Officer Joe Drew on Wednesday named Ellen Levine as the agency's new executive officer for transit operations.
She becomes the first woman to lead the agency's operations unit.
Levine, who is currently western regional operations manager, will oversee all bus and rail services and maintenance, as well as operations planning for the authority's bus and rail fleet.
She replaces Jim Reichert, who was serving on an interim basis.
